svg.text: The Monument That Lives in My Memory: End-to-End Automated Pipeline
Read left to right: Phase 1 governs storyboard validation, SHA-256 cache routing, audio/subtitle tracks & assembly; Phase 2 renders motion on Kaggle T4 GPU.
PHASE 1 • MAIN CONTRACT, SHA-256 CACHE ROUTER & DETERMINISTIC ASSEMBLY ENGINE
Single command: python make_film.py • Unchanged shots replay in 0.15s • Edited shots selectively invalidate only their matching hash

g.text: • Halts bad edits before API spend

svg.text: PHASE 2 • IMAGE-TO-VIDEO MOTION UPGRADE (KAGGLE NVIDIA T4 GPU • WAN 2.2 TI2V-5B)
Takes the 10 verified stills from Phase 1, solves the 16 GB VRAM limit via CPU offloading, generates 73 frames/shot (77.2 GPU min), and feeds back into Assembly
46 Logged Model Calls (runs.jsonl) • SHA-256 Input-Hash Caching (0.15s Replay) • 42 Passing Unit Tests • API Keys Only in .env • $0.00 Total Cash Spend ($0.698 List Value)
